general_provenance_condition.applies_when: A structurally identified similarity plays a substantial role in a fixed capacity-type identity argument under declared Q and C.
general_provenance_condition.requires: Some justification for treating the preserved similarity as source-theoretic or target-level rather than merely as a consequence of the chosen preservation scheme.

relation_to_beni: Beni-style empirical natural-kind constraints may already discharge the general provenance condition; only a live empirically compatible preservation rival activates the stronger burden.
relation_to_brousalis: DR adds a representation-provenance question before comparative evidential weighting: whether the candidate similarity itself depends on a preservation choice that suppresses a C-relevant distinction.
